final_wiki.Q-1995_answer:
2022-03-05 was a Saturday.

Calculation: January 1, 2022 was a Saturday. From Jan 1 to Mar 5 is 31 (Jan) + 28 (Feb, not leap year) + 4 = 63 days. 63 mod 7 = 0, so same day as Jan 1 = Saturday.
